purpose: Define reusable situation/scene construction records that describe playable pressures, questions, turning points and exit vectors without creating Campaign-local or live Scene truth.
controlling_rule: A GCL-03 record is a reusable playable-situation shape. It may say what kind of tension, information, opportunity or problem is present and what could change, but it never asserts which real actors or objects are present, which hidden facts are true, what players choose, how the situation resolves, or that a Scene/Session exists.

nonauthorization: does not create a Campaign, Scene, Session, Encounter or Adventure
does not create Campaign-local placements or overrides
does not establish hidden/reveal or knowledge-state truth
does not establish launch readiness, launch snapshots or Session history
does not require a player choice or resolved outcome
does not mutate reusable source Definitions
does not bypass permission, entitlement, pack or rules-profile checks

stable_id_rule: scene_template_id must begin gcl:situation. and remain stable across wording-only revisions; semantic breaking changes require a new template version or stable ID.
parameterization_rule: Situation/opening patterns may use declared {slot_id} placeholders only. Every placeholder must appear in slot_ids and every slot_id must exist in the controlled slot vocabulary.

slot_vocabulary.semantic_role: second participant, stakeholder or opposing interest
governed place/zone/reference where a consumer may situate the scene
person, object, place, secret, state or goal at issue
clue, sign, testimony, trace or observable indicator
social bond, obligation, rivalry or trust state to be supplied by the consumer
time, social, environmental, logistical or other non-scalar pressure
governed hazard reference or unresolved danger source
barrier, constraint, access problem or complication source
recognized decision maker, institution or rule-enforcing actor
path, passage, itinerary or transition option
device, mechanism, structure, vehicle or other governed technical object
settlement, crew, household, organization or social group
festival, meeting, ceremony, deadline, accident or other bounded occurrence
arrival, departure, threshold or state change framing the scene
deliberately unresolved fact or force the GM may later bind

nonlinear_scene_shape.rule: Templates establish a situation surface with multiple plausible continuations. An exit vector is a possible way the scene can hand off, not a required branch or prediction.

f005_boundary.rule: Materialization may expose unresolved stable-reference slots and composition hooks, but only MV-IA-F005/PPIA-08 consumers create real Scene aggregates, placements, visibility state, launch snapshots or Session state.

map_and_encounter_boundary: A template may say that a location, hazard, route, encounter seed or objective could be bound later; it does not own map calibration/geometry, placement mutation, Encounter composition/balance, or objective runtime truth.
discovery_rule: Intent-first discovery filters construction need, play emphasis, scope, duration, prep depth and tone before expert scene-family browsing.
composition_rule: GCL-03 situations may consume GCL-02 hooks and later compose with GCL-04 encounters, GCL-05 objectives, GCL-06 complications, GCL-09 mysteries, GCL-10 adventures, GCL-13 NPC roles and owning CSW/F005 structures. All results remain proposals until accepted by their consumer.
